Middlesbrough 3-0 Charlton Athletic: Will Lankshear scores twice in Boro win
Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Middlesbrough and Charlton Athletic at the Riverside Stadium on Saturday; Will Lankshear scores twice in a comfortable win for the league leaders.
Saturday 31 October 2026 18:55, UK
In-form Will Lankshear bagged a brace as Middlesbrough maintained their position at the Championship summit with a comprehensive 3-0 victory over Charlton at the Riverside.
Sebastian Berhalter opened the scoring in the 12th minute before Lankshear netted twice to take his tally to 15 in all competitions.
While the early exchanges were not without the odd nervy moment for a home side who came into the match unbeaten in their last 10 league matches, a long throw into the Boro box led to a quick counter and a shot from the division's top scorer Lankshear, resulting in a corner.
Charlton's Tyler Bindon picked up a yellow card inside 10 minutes for a late challenge and the resulting free-kick led to a header into the side-netting from Riley McGree, which seemed to give the home team and supporters a lift.
The first goal came shortly after, with the tricky feet of Amario Cozier-Duberry on the right ensuring he found enough space to pull the back to the edge of the 18-yard box for Berhalter, who produced a tidy finish to the goalkeeper's right. Arthur Okonkwo may well feel he could have done better, however.
Charlton went on to produce a couple of half-chances themselves, including a close-range shot from a wide angle from Joe Rankin-Costello, which was comfortably saved by Radek Vitek.
A deep cross from Cozier-Duberry then found the ever-dangerous Tommy Conway all on his own at the back post, but his curling shot went narrowly wide, while just after the half-hour mark a long Charlton throw was headed goalwards by Miles Leaburn and had Vitek scrambling, but missed the target.
McGree was given a deserved yellow for a heavy challenge on Charlton's Kayne Ramsay in the opposition box after losing control of the ball, with Ramsay having to be replaced at half-time.
The second goal came shortly before the break, with Berhalter producing a sumptuous through ball to find Lankshear. Cries of offside from the away side were ignored by the linesman and Lankshear produced a tidy dink finish to double the lead.
Charlton had a couple of threatening moments at the start of the second half, but Middlesbrough soon took control, with a McGree shot over the bar followed by a curling strike from Cozier-Duberry that looked destined for the top corner but went narrowly wide.
After a couple of dangerous looking crosses from Middlesbrough captain Callum Brittain that were begging to be converted, the victory was finally sealed in the 82nd minute.
Within seconds of being introduced from the bench, Charlton's Nathaniel Chalobah slipped on the edge of his own box and the ball dropped kindly to Lankshear, whose left-foot strike emphatically found the top corner, taking his league tally to 13 goals in as many games.
Lankshear was replaced immediately afterwards with what looked like cramp, with another excellent afternoon's work done and dusted.

The managers
Middlesbrough's Kim Hellberg:
"It helps to play in a team like ours…I don't think there's many teams in Europe that create more chances than us. I think he has unbelievable team-mates around him that suit him very well.
"I think he's exactly the same boy that came through the doors some months ago. There's always a smile on his face, except when he misses chances, even in training.
"A lot of it is about being better every day and that's what you can control. I'm not thinking about what will happen after 46 games in May as that will not help anyone.
"I want to finish first or second of course, but for us it's all about being better."
Charlton's Nathan Jones:
"We felt we were well in the game, but then we never gave ourselves a chance really with that defending and second half we kept giving the ball away.
"We didn't do the basics well enough and we have to find a formula to improve. At the minute we're conceding goals we shouldn't concede.
"We came here last year with a weaker a squad and we kept a clean sheet. We defended for our lives and put our bodies on the line and they're not doing that now. That's the worrying thing and that's what we have to turn around."
digest_he:
מידלסברו שמרה על מקומה בפסגת צ'מפיונשיפ הודות לניצחון ביתי מרשים 0-3 על צ'רלטון אבאת'לטיק באצטדיון ריברסייד. סבסטיאן ברהולטר פתח את רשת האורחים בדקה ה-12 לאחר מבצע אישי מצד אמארי קוזיר-דוברי, והעניק יתרון מוקדם למארחים.

לקראת סוף המחצית הראשונה, ברהולטר מסר כדור עומק מדויק ללנקשיר, שניצל טענת נבדל שלא התקבלה כדי להכפיל את היתרון בבעיטה קשתית מדויקת. בדקה ה-82 נחתם משחקו של לנקשיר כאשר ניצל החלקה בהגנת האורחים כדי לבעוט בעוצמה לחיבורים, והשלים את שערו ה-13 בליגה העונה.

המאמן המנצח קיבץ מחמאות לחלוץ המוכשר ולתמיכה שהוא מקבל מחבריו לקבוצה, בעוד בצד השני הביע המאמן היריב אכזבה עמוקה מהיכולת ההגנתית שגרמה לספיגת שערים קלים נוספים.
